verdict.rationale: Self-hosting the backend is a fair question for an observability platform, but nothing in the evidence documents a self-hosted New Relic stack, a self-hosted architecture, or an upgrade path. The evidence describes agents and OpenTelemetry instrumentation that send data to the hosted New Relic platform. Community comments describe New Relic as a cloud-hosted service with no on-prem deployment option.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can run the full observability stack self-hosted in production with documented architecture and upgrade path
